kicker: For the outcome you can't control
truth: You don't know how this ends, but you already know you won't bow to fear.
prayer: Lord, I don't know how this is going to turn out, and some days that scares me more than I say out loud. Give me a faith that holds steady whether the answer is yes or not yet. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods.

save: Save this for the outcome you can't control
